title: Each A/P report has the Export menu with PDF and CSV
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Each of the three A/P reports has open documents on today's date.
  • Starting screen: Reports (top menu; its left menu lists the A/R reports under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE and the A/P reports under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE) in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  2. Hover over the ⋯ button at the right of the title row.
  3. Click the ⋯ button and read the menu.
  4. Close the menu.
  5. Look along the title row and the filter row for a Print button.
  6. Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  7. Hover over the ⋯ button at the right of the title row.
  8. Click the ⋯ button and read the menu.
  9. Close the menu.
  10. Look along the title row and the filter row for a Print button.
  11. Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
  12. Hover over the ⋯ button at the right of the title row.
  13. Click the ⋯ button and read the menu.
  14. Close the menu.
  15. Look along the title row and the filter row for a Print button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: A/P Summary opens.
  • Step 2: A/P Summary shows a ⋯ button at the right of its title row, labelled "Export report".
  • Step 3: the menu offers "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)".
  • Step 4: the menu closes.
  • Step 5: there is no Print button, and no separate print button: printing is through "Download (PDF)".
  • Step 6: A/P Detail opens.
  • Step 7: A/P Detail shows a ⋯ button at the right of its title row, labelled "Export report".
  • Step 8: the menu offers "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)".
  • Step 9: the menu closes.
  • Step 10: there is no Print button, and no separate print button: printing is through "Download (PDF)".
  • Step 11: A/P Unpaid Invoices opens.
  • Step 12: A/P Unpaid Invoices shows a ⋯ button at the right of its title row, labelled "Export report".
  • Step 13: the menu offers "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)".
  • Step 14: the menu closes.
  • Step 15: there is no Print button, and no separate print button: printing is through "Download (PDF)".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R1: “Each of the six reports has the native report Export menu (the ⋯ button at the right of the title row, labelled "Export report") with "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)". A/R's former Print button is replaced by this menu. The A/P reports gain a PDF.”
  • Out of Scope: “A/P print from a separate print button. A/P printing is delivered through the Export menu's PDF (SV-6163).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p2-a-p-gets-the-same-menu.png: figure "A/P gets the same menu" (This build (after)), board "2. Export"
  • ar-ap-p2-export-menu-pdf-and-csv.png: figure "Export menu: PDF and CSV" (This build (after)), board "2. Export"
  • ar-ap-p2-a-p-no-export-at-all.png: figure "A/P: no export at all" (Production (before)), board "2. Export" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "A/P Summary, Detail and Unpaid Invoices now export PDF and CSV. S3-R1." (caption of "A/P gets the same menu")
  • "The native ⋯ Export menu on all six reports. Files hold exactly the rows on screen, in screen order, with the as-of date and locations, then Past due and the customer or vendor when chosen. S3-R1 to S3-R8, S3-R8a." (caption of "Export menu: PDF and CSV")
  • "The A/P reports have no print, PDF or CSV." (caption of "A/P: no export at all")
